svg.text: (a) Two reflections from one thin film
Ray 1 reflects off the front surface (its phase flips).
Ray 2 makes an extra round trip of about 2nt.
Colors whose crests line up are reinforced;
the others cancel. Change t and the color changes.
computed for a soap film in white light
Left end, thinner than about 30 nm: the two
reflections cancel for every color, so
the film looks black (about to pop).
Thicker films: bands of color that repeat and fade.
Oil slicks and soap bubbles work this way.
